title: Q-SAYDO-year-ships-daily: says ships-daily, does not do it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** say-do check (SAY-DO-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation saydo --probe year:ships-daily
**Status:** open

The system states `ships-daily` (year) and its code does not do it: 0.214 substantive server-originated changes a day (target 1)

Change the code to do what the statement says, or change the statement to what the code does; never weaken the probe.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation saydo --probe year:ships-daily` exits 0.
